title: shower curtain rod
text: shower curtain rod. I needed a strong rod to hang over my tub to hang damp laundry on.  Works great for that.  Strong, a little tricky to set up, twisting for the right tension.  But once you get it up, sturdy.

product_metadata.title: BRIOFOX Tension Curtain Rod 27-43 Inches, Rust-Resistance Shower Curtain Rod for Windows or Doorways, Matte White
features: 1, Heavy Duty, High Strength Steel Tube, Thickness of the tube increased by 60%. Max Load 30 pounds.
2, Rust-Resistance, newest high-tech non-corrosion electroplating. Corrosion resistance capacity doubled.
3, Non-Fall Down, Tension Mechanism inside maintains powerful tension. Max Load 30 Pounds.
4, Apply for All Surface, include wallpaper, paint wall, tile wall, wooden frame, Etc.
5, Briofox Provides Limited Maintenance or Replacement.

details.Usage: Can be used Indoor and Outdoor., For Bathroom, Kitchen, Closet, Stall, Windows, etc.
